text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, at Bubble Gum Fellow's invitation, 
I came to an American-style mega-portion 
dessert shop.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at the pictures on the menu 
is super impactful.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Every single one is supersized! Even sumo 
wrestlers would beam with joy, yes, 
indeed!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It might look like a lot in Japan, but 
back home, finishing one of these all by 
yourself is the proper style!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If you put it that way, I can't very well 
back down from the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I've decided—I'm going to finish a whole 
item by myself! The biggest Blue Hole Cake 
they have!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Bubble-san, YES! My 
frontier spirit won't LOSE either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone ordered their respective sweets 
and ate until they were completely full—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here's a complimentary slice of cake to 
celebrate our grand opening!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Here comes an unexpected additional 
sweet!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! If it's sweets, I can still keep 
going!
choice_data_list:
That'd be too much for one person, let's 
share it.
Let's eat until our hearts are content!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oops, you've got a point. I just have such 
a weak spot for sweets... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hi! I can still keep giving it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone pitched in to share the extra 
food that was served, somehow managing to 
finish it all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You know what they always say, 
right? There's always room for dessert!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We have only been eating sweets, so 
wouldn't there be no "another stomach" 
left?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while being bombarded with sharp 
retorts, Bubble Gum Fellow finished every 
last bite.
